title: Define executable P1-006 playbook registry contract
businessObjective: Prepare one bounded, static, shadow-only playbook-registry contract so P1-006 can later be implemented and independently verified without enabling runtime execution.
technicalObjective: Define the finite V1 registry artifact, schema authority, exact validator command, failure behavior, documentation, and corrected P1-006 packet scope; do not implement the schema, artifact, validator, or verifier admission.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P1-006 remains a static repository contract in Tier 0 shadow mode; no runtime runner, service, database, external call, credential, activation, or promotion is authorized.
The existing P1-006 packet is incomplete because its named validator does not exist and is not admitted by the independent verifier.
Exact validator admission must remain a separate future governance action after the planned validator exists.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design specifies one closed V1 playbook-registry schema authority, one finite shadow-only registry artifact, and one deterministic Node validator with documented failure behavior.

The design defines stable identity, version, owner, Tier 0/shadow mode, production-write prohibition, trigger/evidence requirements, P1-004 policy reference, permitted paths/tools, required checks, approval, retry, and rollback fields without live command execution or credentials.
The P1-006 backlog packet is amended only to the designed static-contract scope and replaces the nonexistent npm validator with the exact future Node validator command.
The design states that a separate verifier-admission packet must admit only the exact future validator command with shell disabled and near-miss rejection coverage.
Independent QA confirms that no registry implementation, schema, validator, verifier change, runtime capability, protected path, or historical evidence was altered.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P1-006-PLAN --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal to add runtime execution, activation, policy authority, external access, credentials, production writes, authorization behavior, payments, booking, RLS, migrations, or workflow correctness.
Any ambiguity about registry authority or exact verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this planning document, P1-006 packet amendment, planning-task state, and its evidence; preserve completed records, canonical architecture sources, and all product/runtime surfaces.
